tasks.short: Train spa staff in product use, sales, programs, and activities.

steps.what: Review current product, program, and activity guidance before staff training
Prepare staff training examples and practice instructions

loop.purpose: Draft practice examples from current spa guidance
loop.input: Selected product and program guidance with learning objectives
loop.check: Manager checks use instructions, restrictions, sales claims, and examples against the supplied guidance
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or instructions are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A native template supplies headings but not varied practice examples based on free text guidance

steps.what: Train staff in product use and sale through demonstrations and practice
Assess staff understanding and explain needed corrections
Record staff training completion and required follow-up

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} training template with checked drafting support, then retain demonstrations and assessment with the manager. Record completion afterward in a native {LMS} form that reuses staff and course identifiers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practice examples and completion records can require repeated preparation and formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting and native completion forms can assist those written parts without replacing teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Safe product use and honest sales practice require observation and corrective feedback.
tasks.human_edge: The manager notices misunderstandings that a completion tick cannot reveal.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time assembling training examples and formatting completion entries.

evidence.claim: A bounded assistant could draft practice examples from selected guidance while native forms reduce repeated completion fields.

assumptions: Preparation writing, live training, assessment, and post-training record entry are separate lifecycle phases.
The manager selects source version, product identifier, restrictions, learning objective, and source locator in s1; all source preparation remains in its 10% share.

In s5 the manager enters staff identifier, course version, completion date, assessment outcome, and follow-up; four retained hours include substantive capture. The form reuses known staff and course fields, never infers competence.
Native templates and forms are tried first. Missing guidance or unsupported examples return to manual preparation; missing assessment outcomes require manager entry.
No automatic notice, enrolment send, certification release, or self-approval on internal saving is proposed. Saving a record itself earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether training material is currently reused
research_questions: Does checked example drafting plus the native completion form reduce total preparation and recording time?

incremental.description: Maintain guidance links, examples, and completion template

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 preparation-and-record scenario: B=100, R=10+9+60+10+4=93; gross 7%, less 3 upkeep gives central net 4%; conservative 0-2%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule guest appointments with reliable availability and explicit confirmation.

steps.what: Discuss guest appointment needs and timing preferences
Record guest service requirements and appointment preferences
Find available guest appointment slots across staff and treatment rooms
Agree a suitable appointment slot with the guest
Enter the agreed guest appointment in the booking calendar
Check the final appointment details and send the guest confirmation

tasks.design: Configure native availability matching in {CALENDAR} from service duration, staff availability, and room availability. The manager captures the request, agrees the slot, records the booking, and checks the final details before sending confirmation through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual searches across staff and room calendars can take several passes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking rules can show feasible slots without a model or autonomous booking agent.
tasks.still_hard: Guest preferences, exceptions, and treatment suitability need direct clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The manager resolves ambiguous requests and confirms the guest's actual choice.
tasks.altitude: Reduce calendar searching while keeping personal appointment handling.

reach.task: Review resource requirements for booked services
reach.learn: Which services require specific qualifications or preparation time

evidence.claim: Native booking rules can match explicit service, staff, and room availability without an AI model.

assumptions: Conversation, request writing, slot lookup, guest agreement, booking writing, and confirmation sending are separate steps.
The manager records service identifier, requested interval, guest identifier, contact, and relevant booking restrictions in s2; all capture time is retained in its 15% share.
The scheduling owner maintains staff qualification, available intervals, room capacity, service duration, and buffer settings; three other-role hours per 100 baseline hours are counted below.
Native matching comes first. Missing availability or undefined service requirements require manual calendar checks; the matcher never infers treatment suitability.
S5 retains all booking entry and earns no saving for the same-system save. S6 retains real confirmation preparation and recipient checking; its gate covers that send, not authoring the booking.
unknowns: Whether native resource matching already exists
research_questions: Can native matching reproduce feasible slots without increasing input maintenance or guest discussion time?

already_counted.description: Request capture and final booking entry

incremental.description: Maintain booking rules and inspect matching failures
Maintain staff qualifications and service resource settings

approvals.approved_version: Exact booking identifier, service, date, time, staff, room, guest contact, and confirmation text checked before sending; changes require a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 manual-search scenario: B=100, R=25+15+0+15+15+10=80; gross 20%, less 5 focal upkeep gives central net 15%; conservative 0-8%. Three other-role hours are additional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell spa products, services, and memberships with accurate till records.

steps.what: Discuss guest needs before recommending products, services, or memberships
Look up product prices, service terms, and membership options
Explain suitable sale options and establish the guest's selection
Enter the selected product, service, or membership in the till
Confirm sale terms with the guest and take payment
Check the completed sale and provide its receipt to the guest

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue shortcuts, membership bundles, and linked terms in the {OPS_SYSTEM} till. Retain personal recommendations, guest agreement, payment handling, and receipt checks while reducing lookup and repeated transaction field entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selling can involve separate price searches and repeated entry of bundle components or membership terms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native till catalogue and bundle settings can reuse current product definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability, truthful explanation, and the guest's informed choice remain personal work.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands hesitation and explains relevant limits without pressuring the guest.
tasks.altitude: Reduce till navigation while keeping the sale conversation personal.

reach.learn: Which restrictions must be clear before purchase

evidence.claim: Native till catalogue and bundle configuration can reduce price lookup and repeated transaction entry.

assumptions: The sale includes separate needs discussion, factual lookup, recommendation, till entry, transaction confirmation, and receipt issue.

The catalogue owner produces item identifier, current price, tax code, bundle components, valid dates, and membership terms; two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover maintaining those settings.
The manager captures chosen item, quantity, guest account, and any permitted variation in s4; twelve retained hours include all substantive capture. No preference or acceptance is inferred.
Native views touch s2 and bundle settings touch repeated line entry in s4. Missing catalogue data or nonstandard terms require manual entry and checking with no saving.
S4's saving is repeated line entry, not a same-system save. The real transaction and receipt actions remain full time, with final-version checks; no automated charge or send is implied.
unknowns: How many sales use standard memberships or product bundles
research_questions: Do catalogue shortcuts reduce till entry time without incorrect prices or missing terms?

already_counted.description: Guest confirmation, payment, and receipt checking

incremental.description: Verify till shortcuts and inspect bundle-entry errors
Maintain catalogue and membership bundle definitions

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected items, quantities, total, membership terms, guest acceptance, and payment amount checked at transaction confirmation; changes require renewed confirmation
Exact completed transaction identifier, receipt amount, items, and intended guest checked before receipt issue; changes require a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 standard-bundle scenario: B=100, R=35+12+15+12+10+5=89; gross 11%, less 3 focal upkeep gives central net 8%; conservative 0-4%. Two other-role hours are additional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and implement spa marketing strategies.

steps.what: Review guest demand and prior marketing results
Choose marketing objectives, audience, offer, and spending limits
Write the marketing plan and draft campaign content

loop.purpose: Draft plan explanations and campaign content within the manager's chosen strategy
loop.input: Strategy brief, selected evidence, and current service descriptions
loop.output: Draft plan and content with factual claims anchored to supplied information
loop.check: Manager checks claims, offer terms, audience relevance, tone, and consistency with available service capacity
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims or unsuitable content return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates do not write audience-specific explanations from mixed marketing evidence

steps.what: Configure the campaign audience, schedule, content, and budget settings
Check the final marketing campaign and launch its customer communications
Review marketing results and decide whether the strategy needs adjustment

tasks.design: Use native result views in {MARKETING_AUTOMATION} and a {DOCS} plan template with bounded drafting support. The manager chooses the strategy, configures the campaign, checks its final version before launch, and interprets results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning a selected strategy into plan prose and campaign wording requires repeated authoring.
tasks.enabler_now: Source restricted drafting can propose content while native campaign controls retain execution boundaries.
tasks.still_hard: Demand, service capacity, and campaign effects require commercial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which offers fit the spa and its guests.
tasks.altitude: Reduce drafting effort while retaining strategy, launch, and spending decisions.

reach.task: Check service capacity for proposed offers
reach.learn: Which offers would overload treatment availability

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting could reduce marketing prose preparation when objectives and factual service information are supplied and checked.

assumptions: The task includes evidence lookup, strategy choice, written plan and content, configuration, launch, and result interpretation.
The manager produces objective, audience definition, offer terms, service capacity constraint, budget limit, and source references in s2; its 25% share includes that preparation.
S4 retains all campaign setting entry and contact-permission checking. Missing facts or uncertain permission require manual resolution, never inferred fields.
Native views and templates are tried first. The only reduced step is checked drafting in s3; existing campaign runtime and same-system saves earn no labour saving.
S5 is an explicit external send/launch with positive human checking time and a gate on the exact final content, audience, schedule, and spending settings.
unknowns: Whether marketing drafting is already templated
What contact permissions and service capacity data are available
research_questions: Does assisted content drafting reduce total time after factual and final-campaign checks?

already_counted.description: Final campaign version and launch check

incremental.description: Maintain drafting guidance and review factual-error patterns

approvals.approved_version: Exact campaign content, offer terms, recipient audience, permission basis, schedule, channel, and spending limits checked immediately before launch; changes require a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 campaign-drafting scenario: B=100, R=20+25+15+10+10+10=90; gross 10%, less 4 upkeep gives central net 6%; conservative 0-3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep guest relationships and operational decisions while simplifying training records, booking searches, till entry, and marketing drafting.
reach: Review treatment constraints with wellness coordinators
Work with catalogue owners on accurate sale definitions
role.ambitious_version: A spa manager with clearer records and fewer repeated screen actions, while personal service and final commercial decisions remain human.
